exp04.action.add_solid: Add Na₂CO₃ to the watch glass
exp04.action.adjust_to_mark: Adjust to the mark with the dropper
exp04.action.place_funnel: Place the funnel on the flask
exp04.action.remove_solid: Remove some Na₂CO₃ from the watch glass
exp04.action.rinse_watch_glass: Rinse the watch glass into the funnel
exp04.action.transfer_solid: Transfer the solid through the funnel
exp04.calc.amount: n = c × V = 1 mol dm⁻³ × 250 cm³ ÷ 1000 cm³ dm⁻³ = 0.25 mol
exp04.calc.mass: m = n × M = 0.25 mol × 106 g mol⁻¹ = 26.5 g
exp04.error.chemical_skin_contact.explan: Avoid touching the chemicals: chemicals can enter the body through the skin.
exp04.error.chemical_skin_contact.messag: The chemical was touched with bare hands.
exp04.error.dirty_flask_used.explanation: The glassware should be well cleaned. Residues may contaminate the standard solution, so its purity cannot be trusted.
exp04.error.dirty_flask_used.message: The solid was transferred into a volumetric flask that had not been cleaned.
exp04.error.dirty_glassware_used.explana: The glassware should be well cleaned. Contamination makes the standard solution unreliable.
exp04.error.dirty_glassware_used.message: Glassware that had not been cleaned came into contact with the solute.
exp04.error.eye_level_incorrect.explanat: Read with your eye level with the bottom of the meniscus; otherwise the volume is wrong.
exp04.error.eye_level_incorrect.message: The meniscus was judged with the eye above or below the mark.
exp04.error.flask_held_by_body.explanati: Handle the volumetric flask only by the neck so that heat from your hands does not cause thermal expansion.
exp04.error.flask_held_by_body.message: The volumetric flask was held by its body.
exp04.error.funnel_not_rinsed.explanatio: All washings must go into the flask; solid left in the funnel lowers the concentration.
exp04.error.funnel_not_rinsed.message: The funnel was not washed into the flask.
exp04.error.incomplete_procedure.explana: The required solution is obtained only when the weighed solute is transferred, dissolved and diluted to 250 cm³. A new attempt is needed.
exp04.error.incomplete_procedure.message: The experiment was submitted before the solution was prepared: no solute reached the flask, or the flask was not made up to the mark.
exp04.error.incomplete_transfer.explanat: Solid that is spilled is lost, so less solute is in the flask and the concentration is lower than intended.
exp04.error.incomplete_transfer.message: Part of the weighed solid did not reach the flask.
exp04.error.insufficient_mixing.explanat: Further mixing is needed to make the solution homogeneous; a sample taken now may not have the stated concentration.
exp04.error.insufficient_mixing.message: The solution was not mixed enough after making up to the mark.
exp04.error.label_incorrect.explanation: The label must show the name of the solution, its concentration and the date it was prepared.
exp04.error.label_incorrect.message: The label is missing information or contains an incorrect name, concentration or date.
exp04.error.label_missing.explanation: Label the solution with its name, concentration and preparation date. Never use chemicals from unlabelled containers.
exp04.error.label_missing.message: The solution was submitted without a label.
exp04.error.mass_out_of_tolerance.explan: The concentration depends directly on the mass of solute: n = m ÷ M.
exp04.error.mass_out_of_tolerance.messag: The mass of Na₂CO₃ transferred was not 26.5 g.
exp04.error.overshoot_mark.explanation: Water cannot be removed without removing solute, so the volume is too large and the concentration too low.
exp04.error.overshoot_mark.message: Water was added past the calibration mark.
Each checklist item protects you from a laboratory hazard.
Not every safety checklist item was confirmed.
exp04.error.safety_not_confirmed.explana: Preparing for laboratory work comes first: read the experiment and know the safety rules.
exp04.error.safety_not_confirmed.message: Laboratory work started before the safety checklist was confirmed.
exp04.error.slider_setting_incorrect.exp: If the sliders are set to the wrong total, balancing the beam gives the wrong mass of solid.
exp04.error.slider_setting_incorrect.mes: The beam sliders were not set to (26.5 + w) g.
exp04.error.tap_water_used.explanation: The procedure uses distilled water. Tap water may add other substances, so the solution's purity cannot be trusted.
exp04.error.tap_water_used.message: Tap water was used instead of distilled water.
exp04.error.undissolved_at_mark.explanat: The solute must be completely dissolved before making up to the mark; otherwise the final volume is not reliable.
exp04.error.undissolved_at_mark.message: Water was added to the mark before all of the solid had dissolved.
exp04.error.watch_glass_not_rinsed.expla: Solid left on the watch glass never reaches the flask, so the concentration is lower than intended.
exp04.error.watch_glass_not_rinsed.messa: The watch glass was not washed into the flask.
exp04.error.wrong_flask_capacity.explana: The final volume sets the concentration: c = n ÷ V. Only a 250 cm³ flask gives 250 cm³ of solution.
exp04.error.wrong_flask_capacity.message: A volumetric flask of the wrong capacity was used.
exp04.measurement.achieved_concentration: c = (transferred mass ÷ 106 g mol⁻¹) ÷ final volume in dm³
exp04.measurement.balance_slider_setting: Total mass set on the beam sliders.
exp04.measurement.transferred_solute_mas: Mass of Na₂CO₃ that actually reached the flask.
exp04.measurement.watch_glass_mass: Mass of the empty watch glass (w).
exp04.measurement.weighed_solute_mass: Mass of Na₂CO₃ weighed on the watch glass.
exp04.objective.aim_glassware_balance: To gain the skill of using glassware and the four beam balance.
exp04.objective.aim_measure_volumes: To develop the skill of measuring volumes.
exp04.objective.aim_prepare_solutions: To gain the competency to prepare solutions of required concentrations.
exp04.objective.outcome_explain_methods: Explains methods of preparation of solutions and dilution.
exp04.observation.liquid_above_mark: The liquid is above the calibration mark.
exp04.observation.liquid_below_mark: The liquid is below the calibration mark.
exp04.observation.meniscus_at_mark: The bottom of the meniscus appears to be on the mark.
exp04.observation.pointer_above_zero: The balance pointer is above zero: there is too much solid.
exp04.observation.pointer_below_zero: The balance pointer is below zero.
exp04.observation.solid_dissolved: No visible solid remains; the solution is clear.
exp04.observation.solid_in_flask_undisso: Undissolved white solid is visible in the flask.
exp04.observation.solid_spilled: Some solid fell outside the funnel and was lost.
exp04.observation.solution_homogeneous: The solution has been mixed thoroughly.
exp04.postlab.q1a.answer: n = 2 mol dm⁻³ × 0.500 dm³ = 1.0 mol; M(NaOH) = 23 + 16 + 1 = 40 g mol⁻¹; m = 40 g. Dissolve 40 g completely and dilute to 500 cm³.
exp04.postlab.q1a.prompt: Briefly explain how 500 cm³ of 2 mol dm⁻³ NaOH solution is prepared. (Na = 23, O = 16, H = 1)
exp04.postlab.q1b.answer: n = 0.2 mol dm⁻³ × 0.100 dm³ = 0.02 mol; M(K₂C₂O₄) = 2×39 + 2×12 + 4×16 = 166 g mol⁻¹; m = 3.32 g. Dissolve 3.32 g completely and dilute to 100 cm³.
exp04.postlab.q1b.prompt: Briefly explain how 100 cm³ of 0.2 mol dm⁻³ K₂C₂O₄ solution is prepared. (K = 39, C = 12, O = 16)
exp04.postlab.q2.prompt: A student says that the concentration of the NaOH solution in question 1(a) could change by a small amount. Discuss why a standard solution with an accurate concentration could not be prepared with NaOH.
exp04.postlab.q3.prompt: Name primary standard substances that could be used to prepare solutions with accurate concentrations.
exp04.prelab.q1.prompt: What are the methods of determining the composition of a solution?
exp04.prelab.q2.answer: Concentration is the amount of solute divided by the volume of the solution; a c mol dm⁻³ solution contains c mol of solute in 1 dm³ of solution.
exp04.prelab.q3.answer: A volumetric flask (used to prepare solutions accurately), beakers, a funnel and a watch glass.
exp04.prelab.q3.prompt: What are the glassware used to prepare a solution of known concentration?
exp04.prereq.concentration_definition: Concentration = amount of solute ÷ volume of solution. A c mol dm⁻³ solution contains c mol of solute in 1 dm³.
exp04.prereq.primary_standard: Primary standards are extremely pure, stable, not hydrated and highly water-soluble, with higher molar masses; anhydrous Na₂CO₃ is an example.
exp04.prereq.standard_solution: A standard solution is a solution with an exactly known concentration.
exp04.safety.closed_shoes: I am not wearing open shoes such as slippers.
exp04.safety.hair_restrained: Long hair is tied back or restrained.
exp04.safety.no_food_drink: I will not eat or drink in the laboratory.
exp04.safety.prepare_before_work: Complete the safety preparation before starting laboratory work.
exp04.safety.read_procedure: I have read the experiment and answered the pre-lab questions.
exp04.safety.report_incidents: I will report spills, glassware breakage and accidents promptly.

exp04.step.add_dissolution_water.hint: Is there enough distilled water in the flask to dissolve the solid?
exp04.step.add_dissolution_water.instruc: Add sufficient distilled water to dissolve the solid. The exact minimum volume is not specified.
exp04.step.add_solid.hint: How will you know the watch glass holds 26.5 g of solid?
exp04.step.add_solid.instruction: Add solid Na₂CO₃ to the watch glass until the balance reads zero.
exp04.step.add_water_near_mark.hint: Why should you stop before the liquid reaches the mark?
exp04.step.add_water_near_mark.instructi: Add distilled water carefully until the level is just below the 250 cm³ mark.
exp04.step.adjust_to_mark.hint: Where should your eye be when you judge the meniscus?
exp04.step.adjust_to_mark.instruction: Use the dropper or a glass tube to bring the bottom of the meniscus to the mark, with your eye level with the mark.
exp04.step.apply_label.hint: What three pieces of information must the label show?
exp04.step.apply_label.instruction: Label the flask with the solution name, its concentration and the preparation date.
exp04.step.clean_glassware.hint: What does the handbook say about the condition of the glassware?
exp04.step.clean_glassware.instruction: Clean the volumetric flask, watch glass and funnel.
exp04.step.confirm_safety.hint: What must you do before any laboratory work begins?
exp04.step.confirm_safety.instruction: Read and confirm each item of the safety checklist.
exp04.step.dissolve_solute.hint: Must the solid be fully dissolved before you add water to the mark?
exp04.step.dissolve_solute.instruction: Holding the flask by the neck, shake until the solid has completely dissolved and no visible solid remains.
exp04.step.mix_solution.hint: Is the solution the same concentration throughout yet?
exp04.step.mix_solution.instruction: Holding the flask by the neck, invert it repeatedly to mix the solution until it is homogeneous.
exp04.step.place_funnel.hint: How can you get all of the solid into the narrow neck of the flask?
exp04.step.place_funnel.instruction: Keep the funnel on the 250 cm³ volumetric flask.
exp04.step.remove_funnel.hint: What must be removed before the flask can be stoppered?
exp04.step.remove_funnel.instruction: Remove the funnel from the flask.
exp04.step.rinse_funnel.hint: Could some solid still be stuck to the funnel?
exp04.step.rinse_funnel.instruction: Wash the funnel with distilled water so that all washings go into the flask.
exp04.step.rinse_watch_glass.hint: Is any solid still left on the watch glass?
exp04.step.rinse_watch_glass.instruction: Wash the watch glass with distilled water from the wash bottle into the funnel.
exp04.step.select_apparatus.hint: Which flask capacity matches the volume of solution you must prepare?
exp04.step.select_apparatus.instruction: Select the 250 cm³ volumetric flask, watch glass, funnel, four beam balance and wash bottle.
exp04.step.set_balance_sliders.hint: What total mass should the balance be set to?
exp04.step.set_balance_sliders.instructi: Set the beam sliders to (26.5 + w) g. The pointer will move below zero.
exp04.step.stopper_for_dissolution.hint: What must you do before shaking the flask?
exp04.step.stopper_for_dissolution.instr: Put the stopper on the flask.
exp04.step.stopper_for_mixing.hint: What must you do before inverting the flask?
exp04.step.stopper_for_mixing.instructio: Put the stopper on the flask.
exp04.step.submit_experiment.hint: Have you completed every step of the procedure?
exp04.step.submit_experiment.instruction: Check your work and submit the experiment.
exp04.step.transfer_solid.hint: Where must all of the weighed solid end up?
exp04.step.transfer_solid.instruction: Add the Na₂CO₃ sample to the flask through the funnel without spilling.
exp04.step.unstopper_for_make_up.hint: Can you add water to a stoppered flask?
exp04.step.unstopper_for_make_up.instruc: Remove the stopper so that you can add more water.
exp04.step.weigh_watch_glass.hint: What must you know before you can set the balance for 26.5 g of solid?
exp04.step.weigh_watch_glass.instruction: Place the watch glass on the four beam balance and record its mass, w g.
